test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Giving cause for legal action
solution: The correct answer is: **Actionable** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Actionable **is an adjective that means "**giving cause for legal action**" (कानूनी कार्रवाई का कारण देना) • **For example- ***The lawyer discussed actionable steps to address the legal issue.* • It is commonly used in legal contexts to describe conduct or speech that can be the basis for a lawsuit or other legal action. • Other synonyms for "actionable" include "litigable," "prosecutable," and "suable." Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Lawful **means permitted or authorized by law. (कानून द्वारा अनुमति या प्राधिकृत) • **Legalizing **means making something legal or lawful. (किसी चीज़ को कानूनी बनाना) • **Objectionable** means causing offence or disapproval. (अपराध या अस्वीकृति उत्पन्न करना) e8:Tc9d, The correct order is: **BADC**
